_note: The component inventory. Every component lists the states it must implement; design_test.go fails if one is missing. A 'seriously polished' app is 80% in these states and 20% in the happy path, so the states are the spec, not the afterthought.

_stateRules.interactive: Every interactive component must implement rest, pressed, focus, disabled. A component missing focus has an accessibility bug, not a gap.
_stateRules.destructive: Anything that deletes must be reversible: the state set must include 'undo' at the screen level.
_stateRules.async: Anything that loads must implement loading, empty and error, not just the loaded state.

components.role: The base surface. Frosted, 40px radius, soft downward shadow (philosophy 6: glass, grain, gravity).
components.notes: culled state must dissolve over 260ms, never snap. A deleted card should feel like it settled off the desk.

components.role: The bruise behind a card. Parametric, animated, respects reduced motion (philosophy 3).
components.notes: Must have a reduced-motion state. An infinitely drifting gradient is exactly the AI-slop motion the design philosophy rejects.

components.role: HoardScore 0-100 on the guilt ramp. The signature data display.
components.notes: The number is never shown without its one-line reason. An unexplained score feels arbitrary; an explained one feels like judgement. Must have a screen-reader label reading band and explanation together.

components.role: The home screen. Irregular, overlapping, never a perfect grid (philosophy 3).
components.notes: empty state copy must be CULL's voice, not 'No bookmarks yet'. Skeleton must be shaped like real content, not a spinner.

components.role: Category label. Hue is meaning (philosophy 2: a lime pill on charcoal is a signal).
components.notes: locked state is the Pro upsell. Hue alone must never carry the category meaning: the label text is always present, and the hue is redundant reinforcement for colour-blind users.

components.role: The roast line as a pull-quote. The app's signature text element (philosophy 4: design references print).
components.notes: Measure is capped. An editorial pull-quote that runs the full width of a phone stops being a pull-quote.

components.role: Cull inbox. Swipe to keep or delete, with brutal copy (Product.md).
components.notes: Destructive: needs hold-to-confirm plus an undo window. MUST have a button alternative for every swipe action -- a swipe-only gesture with no button is an accessibility failure, not a gap. Must announce its state changes to screen readers.

components.role: The shareable 4:5 PNG. This is the marketing (philosophy 7).
components.notes: Must be byte-identical for a given week so it can be regenerated. No logo: the design must be identifiable from the screenshot alone. Must be legible in-app too -- if it only makes sense as an image we have built a screenshot generator, not a product.

components.role: Every action. Four variants, no Material contained-button hierarchy.
components.notes: No elevation levels 1-5 (philosophy 8: no Material). Focus ring is always visible and never removed. loading state must keep the button's width so the layout does not jump.

components.role: FTS5 search as you type, BM25 ranked, highlighted snippets.
components.notes: No-results must say what was searched for. Must survive hostile input without erroring (see TestSearchSurvivesHostileInput).

components.role: The one-line reason a score is what it is. Never a bare number.
components.notes: This is the cheapest intelligence upgrade in the app and the one most likely to be cut under schedule pressure. Do not cut it.

screens.requiredCopy: 3 screens maximum. One shows a live roast of the user's own first three saves, because they should feel smart within 30 seconds (Product.md Day 0).
Offline is a first-class state: every screen must render from local SQLite with no network.
no-screenshot must show a designed gradient placeholder, not a broken image. Capture will fail often enough to matter.
empty means the hoard is clean, which deserves a line about that, not silence.
expiring must state the 30-day window, because the Graveyard is a promise.
The Day-7 moment. It must work in-app and as a shared image.
preview before saving, always. A project created without confirmation is a project the user did not want.
Savage tone is visibly, obviously locked. That lock is the paywall's marketing.

a11yChecklist: Every text pair meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large) -- enforced by TestContrastAA
Every interactive target is at least 48dp -- enforced by TestTouchTargetsAreDeclared
Every motion tier declares a reduced-motion duration -- enforced by TestMotionHasReducedDurations
Every component with a colour meaning also carries a text label
Every swipe gesture has a button equivalent
ScoreDial exposes band and explanation as one screen-reader label
Focus ring is visible on every interactive element and never removed
Layout survives 200% text scale without clipping or overlap
No information is conveyed by colour alone
Reduced motion removes all blob drift and dial count-up; the value still renders
